variants.prompt: In a lavish tent interior adorned with silks and tapestries, Phoebe sits cross-legged on plush cushions, wearing an intricately embroidered choli top and lehnga skirt, her navel chain catching the light, her hands playing with her long, dark hair as she looks up with a sultry, inviting gaze, the camera capturing the rich textures and colors of the harem-inspired setting as it highlights her exotic beauty.
